snippet.title: Two Point Museum: Update 5.0 | OUT NOW!
snippet.description:
Unusual activity has opened up rifts that lead to other worlds in a place/not-place they're calling The Digiverse, a new free expedition map.

The first two Digiverse rifts are ready to be explored: Meat Wizard and DREDGE. The Digiverse is a brand-new expedition map, available once players start the second star in Memento Mile. Each rift holds new Points of Interest (POIs), exhibits, decorations, and more.

Read the full Update 5.0 changes at: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2185060/view/545618256387375629 

Retro Chill Screen (Main Track) by Osynthw
Dredge Music by David Mason / Black Salt Games 

Play Two Point Museum now on PC, Xbox X|S, and PlayStation.

Two Point Museum is coming to Nintendo Switch 2 in 2025.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2185060/Two_Point_Museum/
Xbox X|S: https://www.microsoft.com/store/apps/9nfhrf1m4w3z
PlayStation 5: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10009660
Epic: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/two-point-museum-b884ac
